scope: Actual unchanged CMSIS osThreadNew/IRQ predicate,112-byte static threshold, attr combinations, priority/joinable rules, defaults, static32/dynamic16-bit depth, ignored fields, allocator status and interrupt/mask states
limitations: Native constructors and scheduler-state read are fixtures in this unit. Attribute acceptance does not establish successful kernel construction; priority56 and tiny stacks retain native downstream behavior. No task execution, context switching, hardware or whole-image identity proof.
